details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:459-466 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: applyChatgptWrite rebuilds usage only from the current write, so a PUT with `usage: null` or a missing primary/secondary window overwrites stored five_hour, weekly and resets with null.
  WHY: An account stored at weekly 0.97 whose next run reports timeout with null usage passes the gate, so POST /v1/chatgpt can serve an exhausted account. Severity is MAJOR in every reviewer; MAJOR is mapped to high.
- scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:75-154 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The secret-bearing work directory `RUNNER_TEMP/chatgpt-pool-work.*` is removed only by finish(). The script has no trap, and post.js (lines 9-24) removes only the pool directory.
  WHY: If the step is cancelled mid-request, the OIDC request token, JWT and auth_json files stay on the runner disk. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considered this non-escalating because RUNNER_TEMP is discarded per job, so it did not flag it.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:392 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: parseWindow stores absolute `resets_at` and relative `resets_in_seconds` in the same usage.resets.* field with no marker, and checked_at is not returned by /v1/chatgpt/status.
  WHY: A status consumer cannot tell an epoch from "in N seconds". Severity disagreement: NIT (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash) versus MAJOR (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3); the highest, MAJOR, is mapped to high.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:173,1071-1072 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: ACCOUNT_NAME_RE caps writer account names at 64 characters, while the contract is `^[A-Z0-9_]+$` with no length limit.
  WHY: A longer valid name gets 404 not_found on the writer route. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged the cap safe and did not report it.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:717-721 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate reports 14 contract-test failures plus a ruff failure attributed to this change.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: BLOCKER (google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, confidence 5) versus MAJOR (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, confidence 3); the highest, BLOCKER, is mapped to critical. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash found the failing tests assert repo-state invariants the diff does not touch. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged none of the failures to map to this diff.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:387 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `window_minutes` check and CHATGPT_CHECKED_AT_RE are used only as validators. A format mismatch rejects the whole PUT (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5), and the accepted value is never stored (minimax_minimax-m3).
  WHY: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes a rejected PUT can lose a rotated auth_json. minimax_minimax-m3 says this is not a runtime defect under the current wire contract. Both rate it NIT.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:1087-1106 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The writer route registers the name via POST /names before the PUT. If the PUT then fails with 503, a listed-but-unseeded name stays in the registry.
  WHY: Repeated transient failures can fill the 32-account registry (CHATGPT_MAX_ACCOUNTS) with names that cannot be reclaimed.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:1021-1041 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: readBody treats a missing content-length as 0, which skips the declared-size early exit.
  WHY: The post-read length check still enforces CHATGPT_MAX_BODY_BYTES, so this is a defense-in-depth observation only.
- scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:102-123 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `audience` is interpolated unencoded into the OIDC request URL and is not whitelist-validated.
  WHY: A hostile or misconfigured oidc_audience could inject query parameters. The broker URL pin limits exposure today.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: broker and token-action test suites and CI results
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]

- requirement: the writer account name is specified as `^[A-Z0-9_]+$` with no length limit
  expected_change_site: tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:1071 (ACCOUNT_NAME_RE at :173) and tools/claude-pool-broker/test/broker.test.ts
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: ACCOUNT_NAME_RE is `/^[A-Z0-9_]{1,64}$/` and is applied at index.ts:1071, so it diverges from the wire spec.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:applyChatgptWrite (usage object) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Usage is rebuilt from the current write alone. A PUT with `usage: null` or only one window overwrites the stored five_hour, weekly and resets with null.
  WHY: A stored 0.97 weekly account whose next run reports timeout with null usage passes the 0.9 gate, so POST /v1/chatgpt serves an exhausted account.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:CHATGPT_CHECKED_AT_RE and the window_minutes check in parseWindow | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: checked_at and window_minutes are only stored and never used in a decision, yet a format mismatch returns 400 invalid_body.
  WHY: A writer whose ISO string has no zone suffix, or whose window_minutes is a string, has its whole PUT refused, including a rotated auth_json.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:parseWindow (`reset: resetsAt ?? resetsIn`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: resets_at (absolute) and resets_in_seconds (relative) go into the same field with no marker, and checked_at is not returned by /v1/chatgpt/status.
  WHY: A status consumer cannot turn the reset into a time. This is a design gap rather than a contract break.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "contract tests ... for both modes, every `available=false` reason, masking and cleanup"
  Expected change site: tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py
  Evidence of absence: scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh can return curl_missing and work_dir_failed, but no test drives either.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh:86-88,115-142,146-154; .github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token/post.js:9-24 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Secret-bearing temporary work files (RUNNER_TEMP/chatgpt-pool-work.*) are not guaranteed to be cleaned up if the job is cancelled or crashes, and the post step removes only the account pool directory.
  WHY: OIDC tokens, JWTs or broker responses may persist on the runner disk after the job ends.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:450-495 (applyChatgptWrite) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: applyChatgptWrite builds the new usage object from the write request without preserving existing values, overwriting them with null when missing.
  WHY: Partial usage updates wipe stored five_hour, weekly and resets, which can serve an account over the threshold.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:392 (parseWindow) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: parseWindow stores absolute resets_at and relative resets_in_seconds in the same usage.resets.* field with no discriminator.
  WHY: checked_at is not returned in status, so consumers cannot convert relative durations to absolute ones.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:173,1071-1072 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: ACCOUNT_NAME_RE limits names to 64 characters while the contract specifies no length limit.
  WHY: Valid names between 64 and 100 characters are rejected with 404 not_found.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:Test suite failure | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate reports 14 contract-test failures (agents fragments, changelog fragments, AI labels) plus a ruff failure.
  WHY: Shipping with failing contract tests risks deploying non-compliant infrastructure.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Add the script to docs/scripts-pending-removal.md (§18.F/§20.F registry for introduced scripts).
  Expected change site: docs/scripts-pending-removal.md
  Evidence of absence: scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh is a new script, but no removal-registry entry was created.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Contract tests for the action and script for both modes, every available=false reason, masking and cleanup.
  Expected change site: tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py
  Evidence of absence: scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh defines curl_missing (line 113) and work_dir_failed (line 116), but the tests do not cover them.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
